caption: The drawing depicts a wooden structure resembling a small house or a church, with a red slanted roof and three arched blue windows on the visible side, as well as a triangular-roofed entryway with a narrow rectangular door. To the right of the building, a purple, pink, and white bird with a patterned wing is positioned as if floating on water. In front of the building, there are two pale-colored birds and five human figures; three are standing upright, wearing long clothes and hats, while two others appear to be closer to the entrance. To the left of the figures, there is a cart drawn by a donkey with a man seated on top, another man standing beside the donkey, and a woman in a long blue dress standing nearby. Behind the cart, there are two stylized green trees. Further to the left, the rear of the donkey is visible along with another animal that appears to be a cow, and a small piglet standing separately in the foreground. The background is plain, off-white with a light brown tint at the top, and there is no detailed landscape or sky present. The colors in the drawing are muted and earthy, mainly browns, greens, reds, and blues.
title: Noah's Ark with Animals
